base_prompt:
GAME ICON, transparent background (real alpha channel), no text, no watermark, ONE object centered, nothing cropped, square-ish composition with a little padding.
ART STYLE: match the attached reference's style exactly: Korean messenger-sticker / emoticon style, flat colors with at most one soft shade tone, thin uniform dark outline, no glossy realistic highlights, no texture. Cute, chunky, simple, readable at a very small size.

jobs.name: gift_red
jobs.prompt: A cute gift box: bright red box with a gold ribbon and a gold bow on top, seen from a slight front-top angle.

jobs.name: coal
jobs.prompt: A lump of coal: a chunky rough black rock with 2-3 flat dark-grey facets and a few tiny glowing orange ember cracks.

jobs.name: heart_full
jobs.prompt: A plump red heart (life icon), flat bright red with a small white highlight shape in the upper left.

jobs.name: heart_empty
jobs.prompt: An empty life heart (a lost life): the same plump heart shape as a standard heart icon, filled completely with a SOLID flat dark blue-grey color, with a thin lighter-grey outline ring and one small pale highlight. The fill must be fully opaque everywhere: NO transparent hole, NO see-through area, NO blur.

jobs.name: snow_mound
jobs.prompt: A round soft mound of white snow, like a fluffy dome snow pile: wide at the bottom and rounded on top, about 3 times as wide as it is tall, completely FULLY OPAQUE solid white fill with a pale-blue shade tone along the bottom, a couple of small snow clumps on the surface. The whole mound is one solid shape (no gaps, no transparent areas), landscape orientation.
